name: Focused Hag (Paragon Hag Archetype)
body:
While most paragon hags are tightly connected to their soul focus, these hags define their power by the focuses they carry.

Spell Focus

The focused hag’s soul focus is associated with a particular school of magic: abjuration (amulet), conjuration (cauldron), divination (book), enchantment (ring), evocation (staff), illusion (shawl), necromancy (dagger), or transmutation (broom).

Instead of using soul points to recall spells, a focused hag gains that school’s base focus power as an occultist of the same level. She spends soul points instead of focus to power these effects.

This ability modifies soul focus.

Focus Spells

Whenever a focused hag would gain a family spell, she instead chooses a spell of the same level from the occultist school associated with their focus. The focused hag treats her soul focus as a focus component for these spells. This replaces family spells.
